# optimizelycmp_team (Data Source)

Looks up one team by name. It fails if there is no match or more than one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_team" "marketing" {
  name = "Marketing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the team.
- `user_emails` (List of String)
- `user_ids` (List of String)
